messageSource.note: English (US) text archive; skill table stores message keys resolved here.

notes: Vanilla GameData: the installed build's stats/classes are unchanged by UGF (docs/MODS.md).
English names from RainThunder's fefates-tools enum lists; descriptions from m/@E/GameData.bin.lz.
DLC classes carry a DLC index byte (0-7) at class record +123; skills taught only by DLC classes are flagged dlc.
Anna is the only DLC-only playable unit (curated: 'Anna on the Run' xenologue) — no unit table flag exists.
routes = the character's 'support route' byte (1..7) decoded per docs/DATA.md, cross-checked against route lists.
supportBonuses = C/B/A/S rows x 8 stats, read 40 bytes after the character's guard-stance bonus pointer; verified against Serenes Forest's pair-up tables.
attackBonuses = hit/crit/avoid/dodge rows for no/C/B/A/S support.
The 40-byte block at the guard-stance pointer (named GuardStanceBonuses by FE14 modding tools) is not exposed; its semantics are unconfirmed.
Child class sets: own branch + fixed parent's primary branch (+ variable parent / seal branches at runtime).
Child growths = floor((child growths + variable parent growths) / 2); child cap mods = parents' mods (+1 if the variable parent is not a child).

-2 damage received in battle at the castle.

skills.name: Perfect Pitch
skills.description:
Use "Rally" to heal lower-HP allies within
two spaces for 10% of their HP total.

skills.name: Mischievous
skills.description:
After combat this unit initiates, foe suffers
Def-3 and may lose his or her clothing.

skills.name: Lucky Charm
skills.description:
Grants +20% to the trigger rate for all
this unit's Lck-based skills.

skills.name: Noble Cause
skills.description:
When supported by a damaged unit, grants
+3 damage dealt but +1 damage taken.

skills.name: Optimist
skills.description:
Use "Wait" to gain Spd+4 and Lck+8 for
one turn.

skills.name: Sweet Tooth
skills.description:
Use "Wait" to recover 4 HP as this unit
raids a hidden sweets pouch.

skills.name: Playthings
skills.description:
Adjacent enemies lose 5 HP at start of
each of this unit's turns.

skills.name: Calm
skills.description:
Use "Wait" to gain Skill/Res+4 for
one turn.

skills.name: Haiku
skills.description:
If unit starts a turn between two allies in
a vertical line, they recover 5, 7, and 5 HP.

skills.name: Prodigy
skills.description:
Deals +4 dmg to foes with Str/Mag > this
unit's Str or Mag (whichever is higher).

skills.name: Vendetta
skills.description:
If attacking an enemy this unit previously
fought in this battle, +4 to damage dealt.

skills.name: Gallant
skills.description:
When supporting a female ally, she deals
+2 damage.

skills.name: Guarded Bravery
skills.description:
When supported, grants -2 damage taken.
If unsupported, inflicts +2 damage taken.

skills.name: Fierce Counter
skills.description:
When attacked by male enemy, grants +2
to damage dealt.

skills.name: Goody Basket
skills.description:
Recover 10 HP at the start of each turn.
Trigger % = (Lck stat)

skills.name: Fortunate Son
skills.description:
Allies within two spaces get Ddg+15.
This unit gets Ddg+5.

skills.name: Bibliophile
skills.description:
Grants Crit+10 when this unit is carrying
three or more tomes/scrolls.

skills.name: Sisterhood
skills.description:
Deals +2 damage and takes -2 damage
when supported by a female ally.

skills.name: Daydream
skills.description:
If adjacent to paired male allies, grants
+2 damage dealt and -2 damage taken.

skills.name: Make a Killing
skills.description:
Obtain gold when this unit attacks and
defeats a foe. Trigger % = (Lck stat)
